title: Hetaera's Clutch

'''Hetaera's Clutch''' was a large underwater temple of Elune located in the [[Bay of Storms]], off the coast of [[Azshara]]. It was populated by the children of [[Hetaera]], the [[hydra]]s. Hetaera herself was found swimming the waters a bit north of the Clutch, sometimes sitting on an island there.
